label: Selfie (arm up)
desc: standing, one arm raised high holding a phone above the head (hand and phone out of the top of frame), other arm relaxed, facing camera, upper body

label: Mirror selfie (full body)
desc: standing turned three-quarters toward a mirror, holding a phone at chest height, head turned to the camera, full body

label: Sitting at a table
desc: sitting at a table, both hands resting on the tabletop, torso turned to the camera, looking straight ahead, waist-up

label: Standing, talking
desc: standing relaxed with weight on one leg, both hands raised open at chest height mid-gesture, facing camera

label: Walk & talk
desc: walking toward the camera mid-stride, one arm swinging, the other gesturing, facing camera, full body

label: Selfie (chest height)
desc: holding a phone at arm's length at chest height (hand near the bottom of frame), slight high angle, other arm relaxed, facing camera, upper body

label: Sofa, leaning in
desc: sitting on the edge of a seat, leaning slightly forward, forearms on the thighs with hands loosely clasped, head up facing camera

label: Presenting a product
desc: standing, one hand extended forward presenting an object toward the camera, other arm relaxed, facing camera, upper body

label: Pointing / reaction
desc: standing in a lively posture, one arm raised pointing at the camera, the other hand near the head, facing camera, upper body
